John Altman has fashioned an impressive career as an instrumentalist, big band arranger, popular music producer, and film and television composer. He has been a key member of the music business in London, New York, and Los Angeles.
John was interviewed via Zoom on September 14, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and it’s a great pleasure to have John Altman with me today, from one continent to the other.

I was reading lengthy descriptions of your career and watching videos and this phrase came into my head and I’m going to try it out on you. And the phrase is John Altman is the Quincy Jones of England, and Quincy Jones is the John Altman of America.
